about: Content-Security-Policy violations the E2E collector (H-43, e2e/fixtures/playwright.ts and e2e/fixtures/csp.ts) already knows: each one is recorded and attached to the test, and does not fail it. A ratchet: an entry is added only by a recorded decision, with its reason and its owner, never to silence a red, and removed by the lot that cures it.

entries.reason: cheetah-grid 1.16.7 (both of its builds; it ships no ES module) bundles webpack's global probe, new Function("return this")(), inside a try/catch that falls back to window: harmless under the enforced policy, which blocks it (H-55 v2). Seen by the first cloud smoke on the BRIM table preview (files.spec.ts). Known by its exact sample (H-52): Chromium reports the source the Function constructor builds, and any other eval fails the test. Coverage builds are not concerned: istanbul reaches the global object through globalThis, not through new Function.
entries.owner: H: removed when cheetah-grid stops probing the global with eval (an upgrade, or a bundler that rewrites the probe)
